propositions: The sidecar channel records gate-run limits (request_limit, tool_calls_limit) but not gate-run consumption (requests, tool_calls) due to failure.py:_ALLOWED_FIELDS allowlist excluding the consumption fields
Five of six emit_gate_error call sites in workflow/gate_dispatch.py pass no diagnostic parameter, so gate errors for plan-review and code-review gates record no consumed counter metadata at all
The completion verdict sidecar carries no run metadata (requests, tool_calls, duration), while the plan-review sidecar already carries per-call metrics, creating asymmetry between the two gates
Gate-run consumption metrics are recorded locally in .rebar/usage.jsonl but do not survive to the ticket store sidecar channel, making cost accounting answerable locally but not from the store

The completion sidecar must carry a metrics block (requests, tool_calls, total_ms) on both PASS and FAIL branches to achieve parity with plan-review sidecar and enable rebar audit show to surface consumption data
